description: Hamburg's digital green plan is the cadastre of public green spaces, covering playgrounds, parks, green at allotment sites, allotments and permanent allotments, protective green, sports grounds and cemeteries; key fields are an identifier, location, area, district, quarter and locality, and ownership. The data are compiled from continuous notifications by the city's real estate agency and the districts. Coverage: the city-state of Hamburg, with temporal coverage from 1999. Access: free WFS and WMS services, with each published version archived as GML on the Hamburg transparency portal, where 32 versions exist and the newest record was updated 20 June 2026. Licence: Datenlizenz Deutschland Namensnennung 2.0. Caveats: metaver.de answered HTTP 429 on 2026-09-26, so facts come from the transparency portal records; earlier versions named a predecessor authority. Simulation uses: green infrastructure in urban heat and flood models, access to parks and playgrounds, and tracking change in public green over time through the archived versions. Related records: the Berlin and Münster green space layers.
